job_type_notes: Spend per job type is estimated: the API gives no price per lead, so spend is split over charged leads weighted by the category bid (Plumber $45, HVAC $60).
Target = 20% of the average job value you gave.
Bids are per category: 31.8% of HVAC spend and 0.0% of Plumber spend sit in cut job types, so switch the job type off rather than lower a category bid.
Booked: 27 leads are marked Booked in Local Services; CallRail's Booked tag adds 4 more. Mark those 4 as Booked in Local Services so its reports match.
area_notes: Area comes from CallRail customer_city on matched phone calls. 'not known' holds 20 message leads, 2 phone leads with no matching CallRail call and 2 matched calls with an empty customer_city.
'not known' gets no verdict: there is no area setting to change for it.
6 leads came from outside the area you want (Westbrook).

credits.not_creditable_fix_setting: 6 leads from Westbrook: Google no longer credits out-of-area leads, so remove Westbrook from the service area (fix plan).
credits.rule: Feedback asks Google to look again; Google decides, and a credit is never promised.

reviews.finding: Rating 4.61 is close to the rival median 4.8, but 64 reviews is 119 short of the median 183. Closing that in 6 months takes 19.8 reviews a month against 3.0 now.

unknowns: 2 phone leads did not match a CallRail call; their area is not known and their answered status comes from the Local Services call length.
Rivals were checked for the plumber category only (one paid call); HVAC rivals were not pulled.
